test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a Fundamental Duty?

options.text: To pay income tax in time

solution:
The correct answer is __**To pay income tax in time**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties** are enshrined in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution under Article 51A.
 
• The Fundamental Duties were added by the **42nd Amendment Act in 1976** on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• There are **eleven Fundamental Duties** listed in the Indian Constitution.
 
• Paying income tax in time is **not listed** as one of the Fundamental Duties.
 
• Fundamental Duties include respecting the Constitution, promoting harmony, and safeguarding public property among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution outlines the Fundamental Duties of every citizen of India.
 
• The Fundamental Duties emphasize the importance of a citizen's responsibility towards the nation.
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act**, which introduced the Fundamental Duties, is often referred to as the "mini-Constitution" due to the extensive changes it brought.
 
• The concept of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Constitution of the former Soviet Union.
 
• Unlike Fundamental Rights, the Fundamental Duties are **non-justiciable**, meaning they are not enforceable by the courts.
